*A great limb scythes across the ground, forcing everyone nearby to move.*

### Furnace breath

*Its chest swells and light leaks between its teeth; there is one terrible instant to scatter.*

**Target:** All creatures in a cone of 3 rows, 1/3/5 squares wide. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** fire.

**Weak defense:** Burning 2. **Standard defense:** Burning 1.

**Limit:** Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

details.flavorMarkdown: *An immense red-scaled dragon with a horned head, broad wings and a furnace-bright throat. Intelligent and deeply possessive, it treats territory, tribute and reputation as parts of the same hoard.*

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 2; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Tribute wagons arrive on a schedule; the countryside knows which bells not to ring.

**Purpose:** Keep a domain profitable, obedient and impressed.

**Tactics and retreat:** Open with breath against a cluster, then sweep defenders away from cover; demand terms if the hoard is threatened.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Spread out, contest the hoard or escape route, and bring a bargain with something it cannot simply take.

**Habitat:** Mountain fortress; volcanic valley · **Communication:** Common and Draconic

**Loot:** A single adventure hoard: propose 400 coins plus one reviewed special item, not an item on every scale.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-red-dragon


**Category:** Dragon · **Role:** Territorial sovereign · **CV:** 95

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claw sweep | Brawn | 2 Boons | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. Push each 2. | 10 physical damage. Push each 4. |
| Furnace breath | Brawn | 2 Boons | 5 fire damage. | 7 fire damage. Burning 1. | 10 fire damage. Burning 2. |
| Crushing bite | Brawn | 2 Boons | 6 physical damage. | 8 physical damage; Bleeding 1. | 12 physical damage; Bleeding 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 5/7/10

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 2

**Utility factor:** 1.6

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.162, O=15.075. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [breaking roar](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/breaking-roar.md), [breath](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/breath.md), [red dragon dig in](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/red-dragon-dig-in.md), [sweeping attack](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/sweeping-attack.md), [wing beat](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/wing-beat.md).
